title: One night with the Mack David band
summary: He played one night with the big band next door when their drummer took sick, knowing the arrangements from listening.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: We didn't talk quite enough about that, because you said you used to be allowed to go in rehearsal, but you didn't tell me you actually started to play with them.
I played only one night with them, because their drummer took sick.
And that was, for a big band like that, --
And they had arrangements, I suppose.
But, as I said, I was quick to learn just by listening, --
-- and I knew most all of their
Because they'd had rehearsal there every day at this house, and I lived next door, and I would be there. Just to listen to the band.
And so I knew the numbers.
